free_tier.stated: 10 GiB free storage PER PROJECT on the Free tier, and that 10 GiB explicitly covers 'the project's repository and Large File Storage (LFS)'. Premium/Ultimate: 500 GiB per project. CONFIRMED: LFS is IN the quota while containers, packages, build artifacts, snippets, uploads and wikis are OUT.

egress.terms: Unmetered — GitLab does not bill or publish any LFS bandwidth quota. The only transfer-side control is a rate limit: 'Git LFS requests are subject to authenticated web request rate limits ... 1000 requests per minute per user. Each Git LFS object uploaded or downloaded generates an HTTP request'.

tooling: git-lfs. Also Oras-style raw access is not available; LFS is protocol-only. GitLab REST API v4 for project/namespace management (useful for automating project-per-shard).
chaining: 10 GiB per PROJECT, and projects are free and unlimited within a namespace — GitLab's own excess-storage example totals 30 GiB across three projects with no namespace-level cap. 50 projects = 500 GiB, 100 = 1 TiB. This is the cleanest 'trivially repeatable' LFS case because each project is an independent 10 GiB bucket behind the same account, unlike GitHub where the 10 GiB is per account.
limits_note: At 10 GiB the project goes READ-ONLY: 'you can't push or add large files (LFS) to the project's repository.' Max push request 5 GiB (through Cloudflare) — this applies to git push; LFS object upload is a separate endpoint. Max attachment 100 MiB. Rate limit 1000 LFS req/min/user is the real throughput ceiling (~60k objects/hour, and one object = one request regardless of size).
reliability_note: Read-only state is reversible only by purchasing storage, so a blown project is stuck. The 1000 req/min limit bites hard on many-small-files datasets during clone, and GitLab's own docs warn multi-file projects 'may encounter an HTTP rate limit error' in CI.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

'It includes repository files and Git LFS objects (even when stored in external object storage), but does not include: Artifacts, Containers, Packages, Snippets, Uploads, Wikis'

'Repository size including LFS | 10 GB'; 'Maximum push size | 5 GiB'
